FRONTEND_PROMPT.GOAL: Build a premium, Swiggy/UberEats-level food ordering web interface exclusively for a college campus. The interface must feel smooth, calm, modern, pastel-themed, animated, and professional.

DESIGN_LANGUAGE.COLOR_SCHEME: Soft pastels only (peach, cream, mint, sage, muted orange) No harsh contrast, no neon, no dark blacks
DESIGN_LANGUAGE.LAYOUT: Card-based Floating sections Rounded corners Soft shadows Generous spacing
DESIGN_LANGUAGE.DEPTH: Subtle blur Light glassmorphism Elevation on hover

MOTION_AND_ANIMATION.MICRO_INTERACTIONS: Hover lift Button ripple Add-to-cart pop Quantity soft bounce
MOTION_AND_ANIMATION.MENU_ANIMATION: Staggered card entry Smooth category scroll
MOTION_AND_ANIMATION.LOGIN_EFFECTS: Soft entry animation Success pulse on login
MOTION_AND_ANIMATION.SOUND_EFFECTS: Very subtle click Order placed confirmation Pickup success

PAGES.HOME: Professional food-app style homepage Hero section Category carousel Featured items Live availability badges
PAGES.MENU: Animated food cards Hover effects Availability indicators Group order indicator
PAGES.CART_AND_CHECKOUT: Clean summary Animated transitions Payment selector (RFID / QR) Confirmation animation
PAGES.ORDER_STATUS: Visual progress Pickup prompt Calm feedback animations

PORTALS.STUDENT: Dashboard Wallet card Order history timeline
PORTALS.VENDOR: Minimal fast interface Order queue cards One-tap status updates
PORTALS.ADMIN: Clean tables Soft charts Professional layout

FRONTEND_PROMPT.TECH_EXPECTATION: Modern frontend stack capable of advanced animations GPU-accelerated transitions Mobile-first responsive design
